Did your client deduct TDS but you forgot to note down the amount deducted?
While paying to a freelancer, the client has to deduct TDS at 10 per cent. You
can reduce this TDS amount from your final tax liability while filing an
income tax return. However, the problem can arise if you forgot to write down
the TDS amount deducted by each client. Don't worry; there's a statement which
can help you recall all those amounts easily. What's it? Form 26AS statement.
You can download this statement by logging in to Income Tax Website. This
statement shows the total TDS deducted against your PAN number in a Financial
Year and can be really helpful at the time of filing Income Tax Year. Have any
queries related to Form 26AS? Drop them in the comment section below; I'll be
happy to answer them. P.S. I am creating a guide on "Taxes on Freelancing"
that will contain tax implications in detail and simplest manner. Stay tuned
for more updates. hashtag#incometax hashtag#freelancing hashtag#taxstories
